items.front: AP's regions, area rank and coastline after 2014 bifurcation?
items.back: South-east coast; regions Coastal Andhra & Rayalaseema; area ~1.63 lakh km² (7th largest); coastline ~974 km.
13 → 26 (4 Apr 2022) → 28 (Polavaram HQ Rampachodavaram, Markapuram), in force 31 Dec 2025. Madanapalle NOT a district.

items.front: AP's three physiographic divisions and highest peak?
items.back: Coastal plains, Eastern Ghats, Rayalaseema plateau. Highest = Arma Konda (~1,680 m), tallest of the Eastern Ghats.
items.examPoint: Physiographic divisions - coastal plains, Eastern Ghats, Rayalaseema plateau

items.front: 'Dakshina Ganga' river and AP's major rivers?
items.back: Godavari (largest peninsular river). Majors: Godavari, Krishna, Pennar, Vamsadhara, Nagavali — all drain into Bay of Bengal.

items.front: Vamsadhara & Nagavali are shared with which state?
items.back: Odisha; they drain the north-coastal (Uttarandhra) region.
On the Godavari; a National Project and AP's flagship multipurpose scheme.

items.front: Match AP reservoirs to rivers: Nagarjuna Sagar, Srisailam, Somasila.
items.back: Nagarjuna Sagar & Srisailam = Krishna; Somasila = Pennar; Polavaram = Godavari. Handri-Neeva lifts Krishna to Rayalaseema.

items.front: AP agro-climatic zones — how many and the drought-prone one?
items.back: Six zones; the Scarce Rainfall Zone covers Kurnool & Anantapuramu (Rayalaseema, drought-prone).
Mangampeta (Kadapa) = world-class barytes; Thummalapalli (Kadapa) = uranium; Chimakurthy (Prakasam) = black granite.
items.examPoint: Minerals - Ratna Garbha, barytes, uranium, granite

items.front: AP forest cover vs recorded forest area (ISFR 2023)?
items.back: Forest cover ~18.46% (30,085 km²); recorded/notified forest area ~22.84% (37,221 km²) — distinct figures.
items.examPoint: Forest cover vs notified forest area (ISFR 2023)

items.front: AP mangroves — rank and main sanctuary?
items.back: India's 2nd-largest mangroves (after Sundarbans), in Godavari & Krishna estuaries; Coringa is the principal sanctuary.

items.front: AP's tiger reserve, biosphere reserve and Ramsar/wetland facts?
items.back: Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam (NSTR, among India's largest); Seshachalam Biosphere (Red Sanders); Kolleru = Ramsar; Pulicat shared with TN.
items.examPoint: Protected areas - tiger/elephant/biosphere reserves & national parks

items.front: Jerdon's Courser — status and only habitat?
items.back: Critically endangered nocturnal bird endemic to India, rediscovered 1986; only known habitat = Sri Lankamalleswara WLS (Kadapa).
items.examPoint: Endemic & notable fauna — Jerdon's Courser (Sri Lankamalleswara), Asian elephant (Koundinya)

items.front: AP's dominant forest type, endemic tree, and only wild-elephant sanctuary?
items.back: Southern tropical dry deciduous dominant; Red Sanders endemic to Seshachalam-Palakonda-Lankamalla; Koundinya WLS = only wild elephants.
items.examPoint: Forest types & flora — dry deciduous dominant, Red Sanders, teak, bamboo, mangroves
